question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

Once in a blue moon
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Once in a blue moon"** means something that happens very rarely. (बहुत ही कम)

 
 
• **Example: **He visits his hometown once in a blue moon.
 
 
 
• **"Very rarely"** refers to something that does not happen often. (बहुत ही कम)
 
 
• **Example: **She very rarely eats out, preferring to cook at home.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Every time** (हर बार): Occurring on each occasion.

 
 
• **Example:** Every time I call him, he’s busy.
 
 
 
• **Out of nowhere** (अचानक से): Appearing or happening suddenly.
 
 
• **Example: **The cat appeared out of nowhere.
 
 
 
• **To see a moon** (चाँद देखना): Literal meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** We went to the park to see a moon.
